q: Request queue 98,183,37,122,14,124,65,67 hai aur head 53 par hai. SSTF se total head movement kitna?
explain: SSTF order 53->65->67->37->14->98->122->124->183 deta hai, total movement 236 cylinders.

q: inode ke baare mein kaunsa sahi hai?
options: inode file ka naam store karta hai
inode file ki metadata store karta hai par naam nahi
inode sirf naam store karta hai
inode data blocks store nahi karta pointers bhi nahi
explain: inode permissions, owner, size, timestamps aur data-block pointers rakhta hai; naam directory entry mein hota hai.

q: Target file delete ho jaye to kaunsa link toot (dangling) ho jaata hai?
explain: Soft link sirf path rakhta hai, isliye target delete hone par toot jaata hai; hard link same inode share karta hai to data bana rehta hai.

q: Kaunsa RAID striping + distributed parity use karta hai aur 1 disk fail sambhal leta hai (min 3 disks)?
explain: RAID 5 = striping + distributed parity, ek disk failure survive karta hai, kam se kam 3 disks chahiye.

q: Disk access time mein sabse bada hissa aam taur par kaunsa hota hai aur scheduling kise kam karti hai?
explain: Seek time (head ko sahi track tak le jaana) aksar sabse bada hota hai, isi liye disk scheduling seek movement kam karti hai.
